pin.longFormSummary:
A budget hotel and hostel hybrid near Bordeaux Saint-Jean station, with private family rooms, a shared guest kitchen and a game zone.

Family and budget stay

Book a whole private family room and confirm its bed layout, occupancy and cot needs. Individual dorm beds are a separate product. The guest kitchen supports preparing meals, while shared lounge and game spaces offer somewhere to relax. Check kitchen equipment and house rules.

The property is near Saint-Jean station, rather than directly opposite it. Plan walking or public-transport routes to the historic centre, especially with luggage or young children. Compare the full private-room price, city tax, breakfast, parking, luggage storage and cancellation terms for your dates.

Guest feedback

Guests praise the communal kitchen, quiet rooms and helpful staff. Reviews also note the walk to central sights, parking limitations and cancellation-policy concerns. These are guest accounts; read current room-specific feedback. Component scores are a dated research snapshot.

Opening and capacity

MEININGER announced that the hotel opened on 26 May 2021, with 162 rooms accommodating 493 guests. These are opening-era figures; later directory room counts differ. No property-specific construction investment was verified.

Complete MICHELIN Bordeaux list has no MEININGER match; Forbes Bordeaux directory unavailable; AAA awards exclude France. Acclaim null due guide evidence gap.

pin.longFormSummary:
A family resort at Scottsdale/Salt River with suites, an indoor water park included with overnight stays, and additional paid attractions.

Family water-park stay

Choose the exact suite layout and booked occupancy; themed and larger suites have different beds and limits. Overnight stays include indoor water-park access, with arrival-day and departure-day access subject to operating hours and admission rules. Check height requirements, wristbands and supervision needs.

The operator lists included daily family activities. Adventure Park attractions, the arcade, food and other extras can add to the bill. Compare the complete stay cost including parking, meals, paid activities and packages; this resort is included in Family rather than the Budget shelf.

Guest feedback

Families praise the water park and easy access back to their rooms. Recent accounts also describe inconsistent service, cleaning and maintenance, plus expensive extras. These are guest reports rather than independently established faults. Read current suite-specific reviews and check outdoor-pool operating hours. Scores are a dated snapshot.

Opening and resort development

The resort opened to guests on 27 September 2019, according to contemporary ABC15 reporting. This precedes the formal October celebration.

The Salt River Pima-Maricopa Indian Community newspaper dates the grand-opening ceremony to 17 October 2019 and describes 350 suites and an 85,000-square-foot indoor water park. These are opening-era figures. No verified property-specific construction investment is assigned.

hotel.basis: Read 2026-11-22: Tripadvisor UK snapshot 596 reviews, overall 3.7/5. Rooms 3.9, Service 3.6, Location 4.3, Cleanliness 4.0, Value 3.4, rounded to half steps. Lily firsthand family review displayed April 2025, stay March 2025; exact publication day unavailable, date null. Recent service, cleaning, maintenance and cost tradeoffs retained. Forbes Scottsdale directory has no Great Wolf match; MICHELIN Scottsdale unavailable; AAA Scottsdale directory could not establish exact-property Diamond recognition and timed out on recheck. Acclaim null.
